no_ts_published.note: 4000 W RMS, Dual 2 ohm (final 1 ohm parallel or 4 ohm series), 92.0 dB, 18-150 Hz; MTX 2025 catalogue p.34 table (https://www.mtx.com/MTX006907-MTX-Product-Catalog-2025.pdf, read 2026-11-22); recommended amp 2000-4000 W RMS, sealed 5.47 cu ft / vented 10.2 cu ft net, displacement 653.29 cu in (product page, read 2026-11-22). Cut-out and mounting depth differ between sources: catalogue 22-3/16 in (563 mm) and 24-1/16 in; page 22.25 in and 24.00 in. MTX publishes no T/S values, so it cannot be simulated. Only MTX sub at or above 2000 W RMS (next is the 7515 at 750 W). Older 22 in T9922-22 page returned an error.
